data.long_meaning: The name Divina is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Divya', which means divine. The name is given to the Goddess of Grace and Compassion, evoking a sense of reverence and awe. The name Divina carries the meaning “Goddess of Divine Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Divina usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of divine grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Divina was a celebrated courtesan of the Vijayanagara Empire in the 16th century. She was known for her exceptional beauty and intelligence, and was a favourite of the emperor. Her name means 'divine' in Sanskrit.

Divina was also the name of a 12th century Hindu goddess, who was the goddess of prosperity, abundance and power. She was worshipped in the regions of Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh, and her temples were known for their rich offerings and grandeur.
